g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Belt strap edge hidden by the buckle is omitted; pin/end-division junctions share existing dots. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Magnet body, button body, belt strap and buckle frame receive lower grey surfaces bounded by higher black lines. Open centre, sewing holes, buckle opening and adjustment holes stay white unraised. Pin and terminal divisions remain higher lines. No measured heights, polarity code or realistic shading.
